---
loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader

transforms:
    - taskgraph.transforms.from_deps
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.repackage_set_upstream_mac_kind
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.repackage_l10n
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.name_sanity
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.repackage
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.job
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task
    - comm_taskgraph.transforms.signing

kind-dependencies:
    - l10n-signing
    - shippable-l10n-mac-signing
    - shippable-l10n-mac-notarization
    - toolchain

only-for-build-platforms:
    - linux64-shippable/opt
    - linux64-enterprise-shippable/opt
    - linux64-aarch64-enterprise-shippable/opt
    - macosx64-shippable/opt
    - macosx64-enterprise-shippable/opt
    - win32-shippable/opt
    - win64-shippable/opt
    - win64-enterprise-shippable/opt

tasks:
    repackage-l10n:
        from-deps:
            group-by: single-with-filters
        upstream-mac-kind:
            by-build-platform:
                macosx64-shippable:
                    by-release-level:
                        production: shippable-l10n-mac-notarization
                        staging: shippable-l10n-mac-signing
                default: shippable-l10n-mac-signing
        worker-type: b-linux
        mozharness:
            comm-checkout: true
            clone-with: hg
            config-paths:
                - comm/testing/mozharness/configs
            config:
                by-build-platform:
                    linux64-enterprise.*:
                        - repackage/base.py
                        - repackage/base_enterprise.py
                        - repackage/linux64_signed.py
                    linux64(?!-enterprise).*:
                        - repackage/base.py
                        - repackage/linux64_signed.py
                    macosx64-enterprise.*:
                        - repackage/base.py
                        - repackage/base_enterprise.py
                        - repackage/osx_signed.py
                    macosx64(?!-enterprise).*:
                        - repackage/base.py
                        - repackage/osx_signed.py
                    win32.*:
                        - repackage/base.py
                        - repackage/tb_win32_sfx_stub.py
                        - repackage/win32_signed.py
                    win64-enterprise\b.*:
                        - repackage/base.py
                        - repackage/base_enterprise.py
                        - repackage/tb_win32_sfx_stub.py
                        - repackage/win64_signed.py
                    win64(?!-enterprise)\b.*:
                        - repackage/base.py
                        - repackage/tb_win32_sfx_stub.py
                        - repackage/win64_signed.py
        package-formats:
            by-build-platform:
                linux-.*: [mar]
                linux64.*: [mar]
                macosx64.*: [mar, dmg, pkg]
                win32.*: [mar, installer]
                win64.*: [mar, installer]
        fetches:
            toolchain:
                - linux64-7zz
                - linux64-mar-tools
                - linux64-upx
        treeherder-group: L10n-Rpk
